mapper.sql: portfolio_id, user_id, generation_no, status, initial_amount, cash_balance, opened_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM portfolios WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolios ( user_id, generation_no, status, initial_amount, cash_balance, opened_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{generationNo}, #{status}, #{initialAmount}, #{cashBalance}, #{openedAt}, #{closedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
